title: The Last Alibi
author: Ulyana Nystrom
blurb: Sable Oyelaran, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
